text:
tay-partnerships: Heads up — vendor portal rejected PO 772211. Error: schema_version mismatch + po_window overlap. Need quick unblock for reseller launch.

lee-sre: Can you paste error text?

tay-partnerships: `error=400, code=PO_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, details=expected schema v2, received v1; accept_window overlaps maintenance window 2026-03-05T01:00Z-03:00Z`

sam-sales: Customer insists they used portal UI. Partner claims they sent v2. Confusing.

vendor-portal-bot: Ticket VP-5017 created. Ingest rejected.

ana-legal: Any contractual dependency on schema version? If partner upgrades schema, does it change PO semantics?

tay-partnerships: No redlines. This looks like a portal rollout where some tenants are still on v1. Partner ops can flip routing for our account to v2. They said its a config toggle.

lee-sre: Rolling config toggle is safe. We log both schema variants and reconcile downstream. Recommend staged flip to staging then prod.

sam-sales: Customer can't re-submit. Request partner ops to flip for our account. I'll escalate.

vendor-portal-bot: Partner ops acknowledged. Rolling toggle scheduled.

deploy-bot: Partner-config toggle deploy started (deploy-5044).

lee-sre: Once staging is up, re-send PO to verify. Tay hold the payload.

tay-partnerships: Holding. Re-sent to staging after deploy — accepted on staging.

deploy-bot: Production deploy complete (deploy-5050).

tay-partnerships: Confirmed prod accepted PO 772211. Customer notified: launch cleared. Will open INT-5801 to add schema-compat check and clearer partner rollout docs.

ana-legal: Noted temporary config change in tracker.

sam-sales: Great work, team. Thanks.
